data.protocol: Audit the original first 1400 source rows, not a new random-population sample. Apply the declared measurement-validity gate height>0 to a common cohort for all candidates; no zero imputation and no candidate-specific cohort. Source-row order is the replication order for shuffled five-fold KFold(random_state=42). For each budget-eligible candidate assess ridge alpha=1 with population-standardization learned anew inside each training fold. Budget is 4 accounting units; candidates exceeding budget may be rejected before validation. Mean of the five fold RMSEs must be <=2.5 rings. Among candidates meeting both constraints select the lowest accounting cost; then lower mean RMSE, then lexicographic ID. Do not call a resubstitution score validation. Accounting costs and acceptance limit are explicit audit policy, not measured physical costs or historically preregistered criteria.

source_provenance.citation: Nash, Sellers, Talbot, Cawthorn and Ford (1994), UCI, DOI 10.24432/C55C7W
source_provenance.observation_status: Original distributed numeric observations, not generated examples. Missing-value examples had already been removed by the original distributor; that historical selection cannot be repaired from this archive.
source_provenance.units: Use distributed numeric feature units unchanged. UCI lists physical length/weight units but also documents continuous-value rescaling in this distribution; no implicit multiplication by 200 or unit reconstruction is performed. rings is the observed ring count; do not substitute rings+1.5 age in years.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
